# Harmony tool notices

This private plugin uses the owner's independently installed HDC/USB runtime.
HDC and libusb binaries are not bundled here; their upstream notices are retained.
The old HongJing/Piora mirror HAP has been retired in 0.3.0.
The native video resource has separate vendor provenance and is not covered by MIT;
see resources/native-video/manifest.json and docs/NATIVE_VIDEO.md.
